entries.answer:
Íme egy egysoros shell script, amely létrehoz egy `output.txt` fájlt, és beleírja az összes megadott fájl teljes tartalmát az emoji fejléccel:[1][2]

```bash
> output.txt && for f in binding/Cargo.toml binding/verification_orchestrator.rs config/config.exs config/dev.exs config/prod.exs config/runtime.exs config/test.exs hardware/forth_quantum_control.fth hardware/kvantum_hardver.sv hardware/neural_hardware.balsa hardware/spinalhardware.scala lib/alphafold3_gateway/application.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/back_pressure.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/backend_pool.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/backend_worker.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/metrics_collector.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/parallel_actor.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/quantum_job_manager.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway/rate_limiter.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/channels/job_channel.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/channels/user_socket.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/health_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/metrics_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/page_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/prediction_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/proxy_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/sequence_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/upload_controller.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/plugs/metrics_plug.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/plugs/rate_limit_plug.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/endpoint.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/layouts.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/router.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/telemetry.ex lib/alphafold3_gateway_web.ex metaprog/core.clj metaprog/project.clj model/Manifest.toml model/intelligence_engine.jl model/main.jl model/modelverifaction.blg model/modelverifaction.coq model/modelverifaction.dlfy model/modelverifaction.un model/modelverofaction.idr model/server.jl native/bioinformatics.zig native/build.zig native/main.zig native/memory.zig priv/static/js/api.js priv/static/js/app.js priv/static/js/socket.js priv/static/index.html quantum/All.qs quantum/quantum_server.cr quantum/shard.yml .replit replit.nix shell.nix; do echo "🪼 jaded by Kollár Sándor" >> output.txt; echo "" >> output.txt; cat "$f" >> output.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "" >> output.txt; done
```

A script működése a következő: először kiüríti vagy létrehozza az `output.txt` fájlt, majd végigmegy minden felsorolt fájlon, mindegyik elé beírja a megadott emoji fejlécet, majd a fájl teljes tartalmát bemásolja, végül egy üres sort illeszt be elválasztásként.[3][4][5]
